adoption.reason: Wall-time wave-presence normalization is unverified under power gating and varying clocks. Integrated continuous collection exceeded P95 thresholds; window met observed performance thresholds, but normalization remains a prerequisite.

limitations: Stage P95 values are medians of reported rolling P95 snapshots after warmup, not pooled percentiles.
Timed active workload intervals include kernel launch/synchronization overhead and are a proxy, not direct wall-time WGP occupancy.
Small cohorts and changing baseline timings do not establish causality or prove zero profiling overhead.
Older-boot results are retained separately; one build-overlapped micro trial was excluded and rerun.
First external off run was recovered from successful raw logs after an aggregation-only cam15 selection error.
